newsitem.title: USA: Bangor blames Q2 loss on plant shutdown.
newsitem.headline: Bangor blames Q2 loss on plant shutdown.

text.p: Bangor Hydro-Electric Co Friday attributed its $1 million second-quarter loss on the continuing shutdown of the Maine Yankee Nuclear Power Plant.

Bangor said in a statement it incurs about $1 million a month in replacement power costs while the plant remains shut. The company, which holds a seven percent stake in the plant, said the plant has been inoperative since December 1996.
Bangor reported a loss of $1.0 million, or $0.19 a share, for the quarter ended June 30, compared with a profit of $2.8 million, or $0.32 a share, the year before.
An April 14 First Call estimate of one broker put the company's second-quarter loss at $0.10 a share.
Bangor's stock traded unchanged at 6-3/16 Friday afternoon.
